definition: Said of an assembly that runs across from the jamb: the plate lays it on its side, so its members read outward from the jamb as they are measured and its figures are widths, not heights.
basis: Our wording, read from the pack schema's axis field and the classical trim family's casing member notes. schema/proportion-pack.schema.json, axis description: "across-from-the-jamb: the members run outward from the jamb across the face of a casing, and each height_parts is therefore a width, so a plate that draws the assembly draws it turned."; proportions/systems/trim-classical.json assemblies.casing_federal.members[fed_cas_reveal].note: "Measured across the casing, as in the Georgian assembly."; proportions/systems/trim-classical.json assemblies.casing_greek_revival.members[grk_cas_reveal].note: "Measured across the casing, as in the other two families.".
